items.title: Ncell Foundation to help reopen flood-damaged campus in Nuwakot
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 22 Ncell Foundation will provide educational infrastructure support to resume classes at Tribhuvan Trishuli Multiple Campus in Bidur, Nuwakot. The foundation has signed a memorandum of understanding with Bidur Municipality to support the campus, which was severely damaged by the Bhotekoshi River flood on August 26.
